notes: CAIRN 0.7b - PRE-RELEASE (alpha). Compatibility drop after the 0.7a rename era: legacy MARA_* env spellings removed except the four state-location vars (MARA_HOME, MARA_REGISTRY, MARA_HOST, MARA_PORT) which are still read one more release for update-harness compatibility and go away at 0.7c; the X-Mara-Slug request header is no longer accepted (X-Cairn-Slug only); default-path ladders to /etc/mara and /var/lib/mara are gone. Operators with systemd units must set the CAIRN_* env names (values unchanged). This build is ALPHA: auto-update remains owner-confirmed, databases are never auto-restored, and pre-release builds may break. Crossers from 0.6x: run the migration ferry (cairn-migrate.py, --dry-run first) BEFORE updating. Nonce 19.
